title: TopoMarket v1.1 - market structure and experimental warning evidence
release_identity: v1.1.0, recorded from the public Streamlit Community Cloud deployment after anonymous smoke checks

scenes.picture: GitHub social preview (1280x640) fitted to 16:9 without distortion; exact URL and product claim
scenes.narration: TopoMarket visualizes market structure and tests whether topology can warn of sharp declines.

scenes.picture: Market Structure Studio: two-window comparison with both dates and qualified-pair counts; honest regime-contrast wording; fixed layout/threshold/scale
scenes.narration: These twelve industry portfolios contrast two market regimes. Watch how the network becomes far more connected under stress.

scenes.picture: Direct manipulation: Finance selected in the interactive correlation network, then Mapper view with volatility bands and highlighted shared-portfolio edge
scenes.narration: Explore the relationships directly. Mapper connects groups that share industry portfolios.

scenes.picture: Guided alert example: selected date, alert explanation with the 56-point Takens window and the H1 birth-death diagram; actual percentile and frozen threshold visible
scenes.narration: A separate indicator studies the shape of recent S and P five hundred returns. This percentile measures unusual behavior.

scenes.picture: Blind Replay (neutral alert state, no outcome), then explicit reveal of the actual next 20 closes, origin/threshold/actual decline; honest late-warning statement
scenes.narration: Now test the warning without hindsight. Reveal the next twenty sessions and see whether the index fell ten percent. The decline had already begun; the next twenty sessions did not reach the ten percent target.

scenes.picture: Validation screen: large three-method evidence metrics and comparison chart with synthetic label; no positive-prediction claim
scenes.narration: Forecasting remains experimental. Compare the results with simpler benchmarks.

scenes.picture: Static branded card with the exact URL github.com/SergeyGer/TopoMarket for the full five seconds
scenes.narration: Explore the code and the live demo on GitHub.
